title: A Pilot Study to Evaluate Multi-Spectral and Laser Speckle Imaging and Multiphoton Microscopy During Vascular Occlusion
official: A Pilot Study to Evaluate Multi-Spectral Imaging (MI) and Laser Speckle Imaging (LSI) and Multiphoton Microscopy (MPM) During Vascular Occlusion
summary: The purpose of this research is to evaluate and validate the performance of non-invasive imaging modalities for assessment of skin. A pressure cuff occlusion will be used to stimulate blood flow dynamic that these instruments are designed to sense. The researcher currently plan to assess only basic feasibility of the imaging instruments.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male and female adult 18 years and older

Exclusion Criteria:

* Younger than 18 years of age
* Pregnant women
